settings.content: We want you to love every VELD piece. If something isn't right, we make it easy to return.

EU customers may return any full-price item within 30 days of delivery, free of charge. Items must be in their original, unworn condition with all tags attached and in original packaging.

Sale items (marked with a red price) are final sale and cannot be returned unless faulty.

1. Log in to your account and navigate to your order.
2. Select the items you wish to return and your reason.
3. Download and print your prepaid DHL return label.
4. Pack the item securely in the original box or a plain box.
5. Drop it off at any DHL ServicePoint.

We recommend keeping your proof of postage until your refund is confirmed.

settings.text: Returns from outside the EU may incur a return shipping fee. Please contact us at hello@veld-studio.com before returning.

settings.content: Once we receive your return, we inspect it within 2 business days. Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. You'll receive an email confirmation at each step.

We do not process direct exchanges. To get the correct size or colour, return your original item for a full refund and place a new order. This ensures your preferred item doesn't sell out while you wait.

If you receive a faulty or incorrect item, please contact us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos. We will arrange collection and replacement at no cost to you, or issue a full refund including original shipping.

settings.intro_text: We want you to love every VELD piece. Free returns within 30 days for EU customers.
